title: individual_restricted_detail
description: The sensitive, optional facts about one individual, held apart from the individual so security rules and exports can treat them separately: blood type, skin type, recorded sex, gender identity, clinical sex, veteran status and cause of death. Nothing here is collected by default. A record may be written only with a purpose and either a consent_ref or a legal_basis, and each field only for a purpose it allows. Reads are limited by role and logged by id. Disability and health conditions are not here; they are the later accessibility_profile and health_profile schemas. Sexual orientation and anything sexual are not in any schema. Endpoint rules the schema cannot express: one record per individual; the individual must exist; the purpose must be one the field allows; the record is erased when the individual is erased.
x_retention: Kept only as long as the purpose lasts and the consent is not withdrawn; removed with the individual on erasure. A minor's details need guardian consent and are reviewed at 18. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet.)

individual_id.description: The individual this detail belongs to (a UUID). Required. At most one restricted-detail record per individual (endpoint rule).

purpose.description: Why these details are held: registration, safety, billing, certification, research or health_care. Required. A field may be written only for a purpose it allows (see x_allowed_purposes on each field).

consent_ref.description: Reference to the consent record that covers this purpose (a UUID once the consent schema exists). Required unless legal_basis is given.

legal_basis.description: Another lawful basis when there is no consent: vital_interests, legal_obligation or public_interest. Required unless consent_ref is given.

blood_type_abo.description: ABO blood group: A, B, AB, O or unknown. Health data. Allowed purposes: safety, health_care.

blood_type_rh.description: Rh factor: positive, negative or unknown. Health data. Allowed purposes: safety, health_care.

skin_tone_scale.description: Fitzpatrick skin type: type_1 to type_6 or unknown. Not ethnicity. Allowed purposes: safety, health_care.

sex_recorded.description: Recorded sex on a source document: female, male, other or unknown. The concept is the recorded sex, not gender identity. Allowed purposes: registration, health_care, certification.

gender_identity.description: Gender identity as the person states it, free text up to 100 characters. Person-stated only. Allowed purposes: registration, research.

sex_for_clinical_use.description: Sex parameter for clinical use: female, male, specified, unknown. Health products only. Allowed purposes: health_care.

veteran_status.description: Whether the person is a military veteran: yes, no or unknown. A cached flag; the military_service schema (later) is the source. Allowed purposes: registration, certification.

death_cause.description: Cause of death in words. Health data; collected only when a lawful basis exists. Allowed purposes: health_care, research.

notes.description: Operator notes on these details, free text. Allowed purposes: any.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id. Never sent by a browser.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC, ISO 8601). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created the record. Who acted, as an actor string such as user:<uuid>. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server. A change must name the updated_at it read.

updated_by.description: Who last changed the record. Who acted, as an actor string such as user:<uuid>. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Restricted details are never taken from a public page. Set by the server.
